binary_path.description: Path to the compiled binary used to generate coverage data.

branch.description: Enable parsing of branch coverage data.

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA corresponding to the coverage data.

excl_br_line.description: Regex marker to exclude lines from branch coverage analysis.

excl_br_start.description: Regex marking start of excluded section for branch coverage.

excl_br_stop.description: Regex marking end of excluded section for branch coverage.

excl_line.description: Regex marker to exclude lines from line coverage analysis.

excl_start.description: Regex marking start of excluded section for line coverage.

excl_stop.description: Regex marking end of excluded section for line coverage.

guess_directory_when_missing.description: Guess directory structure when missing in coverage data.

ignore.description: List of glob patterns to exclude from coverage analysis.

ignore_not_existing.description: Ignore source files that don't exist on disk.

keep_only.description: List of glob patterns — only files matching these are included.

llvm.description: Optimize parsing for LLVM-generated coverage data only.

log_level.description: Log level: OFF, ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG, TRACE.

output_config_file.description: Path to write output configuration file (used internally).

output_path.description: Output path — a single file for one output type, a directory for multiple.

output_types.description: List of output formats. Supported: html, coveralls, lcov, covdir, coveralls+, ade, files, markdown, cobertura, cobertura-pretty.

parallel.description: Enable parallel build mode for Coveralls.

paths.description: List of input paths (files/directories) to analyze for coverage data.

precision.description: Decimal precision for coverage percentages in output reports.

prefix_dir.description: Prefix path to remove from file paths in coverage report.

service_flag_name.description: Flag name for Coveralls parallel builds.

service_number.description: CI service build or run number.

sort_output_types.description: List of output types to sort files lexicographically for.

threads.description: Number of threads to use for processing.

token.description: Coveralls repository token (required for 'coveralls' and 'coveralls+' output types).

vcs_branch.description: VCS branch name for Coveralls report.
